objective: Connect the local AEGIS operator dashboard to one governed asynchronous Claude subscription worker, stream truthful lifecycle evidence, harden independent review transport, and replace the diagnostic-first surface with a founder-readable command deck.
constraints: AEGIS dashboard and build-engine only; do not touch the Vitalis peptide protocol engine or unrelated projects
Browser input cannot select an executable, command, provider, model, permission mode, environment variable, or filesystem path
The Claude subscription worker uses a fixed executable and validated argv without a shell
All lifecycle changes remain owned by aegis-run transition authority and the canonical ledger
Authentication is never presented as connector usage
Pause remains unavailable until tested suspend and resume semantics exist
Packet testsRequired execute only snapshot-safe deterministic checks inside the immutable check boundary; an exact command receipt is mandatory

The canonical check authority must execute `node builder-control/test/host-containment.test.cjs` once at the top-level macOS host boundary after snapshot checks pass and bind its zero-skip receipt to this exact packet and subject
Missing, stale, wrong-subject, wrong-packet, non-macOS, nonzero, truncated, failed, or skipped top-level host containment evidence blocks review binding, checkpoint, and the final governed gate
Live OS containment may be claimed only from the bound top-level host containment receipt, never from profile-only snapshot checks
No deploy, release, merge, publication, purchase, or protected-branch mutation
stopConditions: A browser-controlled value can reach shell execution or provider selection
A second lifecycle, ledger, verdict, permission, or routing authority appears
An active AEGIS builder or reviewer already owns the packet
Independent review reports a verified OPEN CRITICAL or HIGH finding on the exact subject
Marc changes scope or issues STOP
